status: read-only assessment; no source qualification, repair approval, ownership change, observer, or physical replay

contract.original_question: Qualify the unique current-location source membership, retained territorial exclusions and complete source competitors; then derive and verify a zero-reassignment additive native patch.
contract.original_completion: Every exact interval is either a qualified additive repair to its recorded location or a documented exception; run actual selected-native conservation and source/physical witness checks. Existing river water remains location-owned.
contract.interpretation: For a positive additive repair to the unchanged recorded target, the decisive evidence is exact target-specific source applicability and native eligibility for the requested keys, while preserving the stable owner and all existing assignments. A modern administrative crosswalk is not an independent blanket requirement solely because an input is old; it is needed to resolve target identity only where the legal reorganization makes that specific source-to-target relation ambiguous or changed.

retained_fact_patterns.source_family: Complete pinned BDI ADM2 family has 119 features and catalogued represented-year claim 2007, catalogue label Public Domain; original BDI ADM1 is 18 features/2014/CC0, COD ADM1 26/2017/ODbL, TZA ADM1 30/2015/ODbL.
retained_fact_patterns.point_comparison: Previously retained comparison reports 583/583 requested centers within the expected BDI ADM2 feature, 583/583 physical expected-class hits, no original centers intersecting retained adverse physical issue geometries, and 54 foreign ADM1 contact rows (51 TZA, 3 COD). These establish relevant observed predicates, not source currency/authority, whole-target clearance, or the unrun/unchecked present source-native constructor.
retained_fact_patterns.contacts: 21 BDI ADM2 direct owner contacts match reverse lineage; 9 parent-level BDI ADM1 contacts and 3 foreign ADM1 contacts have no direct owner vectors. Keep parent/foreign contacts in complete competitor and exclusion checks; do not count them as direct owners or dismiss them from their labels.
retained_fact_patterns.water: 205 inland-water keys remain in the denominator. Their original recorded class must remain and the original queue mask is not a present physical approval.

official_reform_evidence.source: Organic Law No. 1/05 of 16 March 2023, official CENI-hosted copy
official_reform_evidence.finding: Enacted reorganization defines current provinces, communes, zones and neighborhoods. Browser opened 78-page PDF but returned no extractable text. Prior retained research reports 5 provinces, 42 communes, 451 zones; detailed old-to-new annex assignment was not independently readable here.
official_reform_evidence.implication: The reform is a real applicability input, not proof that each 2007 BDI ADM2 feature changed or that every old target needs a full crosswalk.
official_reform_evidence.search_indexed_detail: Targeted search of the official CENI-hosted enacted-law PDF indexed the names Commune Muhuta and Bugarama in annex text. The PDF browser exposes no text lines and find cannot locate the name, so the annex heading/context for Bugarama is not independently confirmed; do not treat the snippet as a crosswalk.

official_reform_evidence.source: INSBU Annuaire Statistique du Burundi, édition 2024 (published August 2026), Tableau 1.05
official_reform_evidence.finding: Post-reform census statistics list current province/commune groupings, including Muhuta and Ntahangwa under Bujumbura and Gisagara/Muyinga under Buhumuza; source lines 903-925 show the table and entries.
official_reform_evidence.limitation: Statistical current-unit names/counts do not give boundary polygons or a cell-level crosswalk.

official_reform_evidence.source: Senate-hosted 2022 draft organic law and explanatory text
official_reform_evidence.finding: Retained search-indexed evidence says the proposal would combine the old Bugarama and Muhuta communes into proposed Muhuta.
official_reform_evidence.limitation: Draft proposal, not proof of enacted feature boundaries. Do not assign cells from this alone.

official_reform_evidence.source: Presidency Council of Ministers communiqué, 18 September 2025
official_reform_evidence.finding: Retained research describes the reorganization as implemented in 2025.
official_reform_evidence.limitation: Confirms contemporary operational reorganization, not old-to-new geospatial equivalence.

positive_witness_required: Authenticate the canonical part bodies and verify each of the 21 unchanged target IDs/owners is still the intended stable canonical location; the current locator file gives immutable part locators but part bodies were not locally read at assessment time.

For each proposed key, establish exact source-target membership against a complete, appropriately scoped source family, retain every parent/foreign contact and territorial exclusion, and refuse ambiguous competitors or boundary ties. Raw source ID/hash and historic center overlap alone are not qualification.

Where the reorganization could alter a particular target relation, provide a target-specific authoritative bridge (for example, an enacted annex/member list or current suitable geometry plus an exact membership join) only for that relation/key. If the canonical target is deliberately a stable historical source entity and the repair does not redefine it, document that semantics and the retained identity/lineage; do not demand a blanket all-42 crosswalk merely from the 2007 date.

Bind the actual positive candidate to the stock source/native predicates, actual physical support and current selected-owner/conservation checks. The already retained center comparison, queue mask, and zero-owner observation do not substitute for whole-target physical and native qualification.
not_yet_established: Whether the original stable canonical target semantics intentionally remain the 2007 ADM2 entities after the law, versus being expected to follow current 42 commune entities; this needs explicit contract/product semantics, not assumption.

Whether any target among the 21 was split, merged, or had a boundary altered in a way that affects one of the 583 candidate keys; no authenticated full crosswalk/current boundary layer was joined in this assessment.
Detailed enacted-law annex interpretation for all 21 targets; official PDF was not machine-readable in the opened copy.
Whole-target physical result/receipt and any current source-native qualification result; prior retained physical center comparison and queue masks are not these outputs.
method_limits: No source geometry or physical geometry was inspected or recomputed in this assessment.
No ownership observer, physical producer, or qualification constructor was rerun.
No law or catalogue claim is treated as blanket source authority or per-cell proof.
The canonical part locator is index/chunk-derived until parent verifies the acquired part bodies.
specific_target_implication: Bugarama is a concrete target for exact treatment because retained draft/reform references and current name structure suggest a changed administrative relation. Resolve Bugarama (and any other demonstrably affected targets) with the enacted annex or exact current authoritative boundary/member evidence before extending the stable target there. This does not imply every BDI ADM2 target needs a modern 42-commune crosswalk merely because its source is dated 2007.
